title: Collaboration Workspace Access Missing After Team Transfer
content: Synthetic incident at Example Manufacturing. A user moved from Business Operations to Product Delivery and could sign in to the collaboration platform but could not open the Product Delivery workspace. Investigation found that the workspace membership cache had not reflected the approved team transfer. IT Support verified membership and role-synchronization status without changing access. The user fully signed out, reopened the browser, and signed in again. The unresolved request was escalated to Enterprise Applications Support for authorized membership review. This historical incident does not confirm the cause of a new user's issue.
